paragraphs.text: Story 1
Scene 1
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，A location phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the main verb “玩.”
装祭拜：假装祭拜，“装” does not naturally take an action verb directly in this meaning;“假装” means to pretend to do an action.
In S4 but missing in S5: 妈妈带着他搬家，跟孟子搬家 means that Mengzi moves together with his mother, but the intended meaning is that his mother takes the young Mengzi with her when she moves.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。孟子小的时候，This is the first mention of the main character, so use a brief introduction with the name and a full noun phrase.
Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the referent has just been named and no other person competes as the main subject.
Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，Use 了 for the completed single action of moving house at age five.
Expressiveness: After “装祭拜,” add Mengzi’s feeling to show why he does it, for example:“他觉得祭拜很好玩。”
Expressiveness: Add an action detail to make the pretending more vivid, for example: “他一边笑，一边学着别人祭拜。”
Expressiveness: At the final sentence, show the mother’s concern with an inner thought, for example: “妈妈心想：‘住在墓地旁边不太好。’”
Encouragement
You clearly show the reason for the family’s move with the contrast structure “不是因为……而是因为……,” which fits the sentence very well.
Your scene has a clear focus on Mengzi’s childhood behavior and his mother’s decision.
Scene 2
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气：住得离墓地太近，会影响孟子的心情，use 得 after 住before a degree or distance complement; also, 害得 must be followed by a result state, while 心气 alone does not state a result.
老是读书：一直读书，老是 has a negative, complaining tone; 一直 neutrally describes an ongoing study habit.
Vocabulary Suggestions
In S4 but missing in S5 (“good suggestion”): 教 -- “教她的儿子”：教导，sounds a little more like guiding a child’s learning and behavior；辅导，focuses on helping someone study.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母搬到了子思老师的家：他们搬到了子思老师的家，use a pronoun for close re-occurrence: both characters were mentioned in the previous sentence, and no competing pair makes 他们 unclear.
Coherence (Temporality): 搬到子思老师的家：搬到了子思老师的家，use 了 for the completed moving action in this narrative sequence.
Coherence (Conjunction): 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他一直读书：因为孟子现在没有朋友，所以他一直读书，use 因为……所以…… to connect the cause with its result.
Expressiveness: After the move, add a feeling to show how the lack of friends affects him, for example: “孟子觉得很孤单，只好一个人读书。”
Expressiveness: When describing the teacher’s help, add a short line of speech to make the scene livelier, for example: “子思老师说：‘孟子，你可以跟我一起学习。’”
Encouragement You clearly show how the family’s new living situation changes Mengzi’s daily life. You also use the cause word 因为 to connect his lack of friends with his studying.
Scene 3
子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
他成为很有名的哲学家：他成为了很有名的哲学家，Add 了 because becoming a philosopher is presented as a completed change of state in the narrative.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 孟子从五岁一直学哲学：他从五岁一直在学习哲学，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence: 孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence, and no other male character competes as the referent.
Coherence (Temporality): 一直学哲学：一直在学习哲学，Use 一直在 + verb for an action presented as continuously ongoing over a period of time.
Expressiveness: At the sentence about writing and reading, add a small study detail, such as “孟子不是练习写文章，就是认真地看哲学书。”
Expressiveness: After the final sentence, add Mengzi’s feeling or thought, such as “他觉得学哲学很有意思，也想知道很多重要的问题。”
Encouragement
You used the “不是……就是……” pattern very well to show Mengzi’s two regular study activities. The “才……就……” structure is also used correctly and makes his early start in philosophy clear.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Scene 2: The required market scene is missing. After leaving the graveyard, 孟母 and 孟子 should move near a market, where 孟子 imitates buying and selling every day.
Scene 2: The move to a school neighborhood is misremembered as moving to 子思老师’s house. The story needs 孟母 to move from the market to near a school, and then 孟子begins studying every day.

Overall Encouragement You included the graveyard beginning,孟母’s reason for moving, and the ending where 孟子becomes a famous philosopher. Your retelling clearly shows how his environment helped shape his learning.
Story 2:
Scene 1
有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
不合适的地方让孩子玩：不适合孩子玩儿的地方，适合 takes the person or activity as its complement; placing the activity before 的 correctly describes a place that is unsuitable for a child to play in.
住在这儿教育不太好：这儿的教育环境不太好，教育环境 is the noun phrase that can be described as good or bad; 住在这儿 cannot directly function as the modifier of 教育 in this sentence.
会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育：得一直搬家，才能找到质量好的教育，得expresses the necessary condition required before 才能; 会 only expresses future possibility or prediction.
恐怕 -- “她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福”：担心, this directly expresses the mother’s worry；害怕, this is stronger and expresses fear rather than concern.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 孟子：小男孩孟子，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a brief noun phrase rather than using only his name.
Coherence (Reference): 他妈妈：孟子的妈妈，This is the mother’s first mention, so use a full noun phrase to introduce her clearly before later using pronouns.
Coherence (Temporality): 决定了：决定，决定 is a mental-state verb, so it normally takes the zero particle rather than 了.
Expressiveness: At the mention of the cemetery, add a concrete detail about what the child sees, such as “他看到很多人来墓地祭拜”.
Expressiveness: After the mother’s concern, add her feeling or inner thought, such as “孟子的妈妈很担心儿子会学别人祭拜”.
Expressiveness: You could include a short line of quoted speech when she decides to move, such as “这儿不适合孩子长大，我们得搬家”.
她决定了他们会搬家：她决定搬家，delete “他们”, redundant, delete “会”, 决定 implies “will do”, so “会” is redundant.
Encouragement
You clearly connect the mother’s hope for her son with her decision to move by using 因为……所以…….
You also use completed actions accurately in 去了 and 搬到了, which makes the sequence of events easy to follow.
Scene 2
他们住才一月就又搬家。古代的时候，一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，害得妈妈着急得很，因为她恐怕儿子会成为跟他们很像。她告诉了孟子：他们不是朋友，而是不好的人。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
住才一月：才住一个月，才 should come before the verb, and a duration is normally expressed with a measure word as in 一个􀀀.
害得妈妈着急得很：让妈妈很着急，害得 requires a clearly harmful consequence; being anxious is an emotional reaction, so 让 is the appropriate causative verb here.
成为跟他们很像：成为跟他们很像的人，成为 needs a noun phrase describing the new identity or role; add 人 after the descriptive phrase.
古代的时候：在古代，Use “在古代” for a general historical time setting; “古代的时候” is not the natural form here.
老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿：老是跟这些卖东西的人玩儿，Both “老是” and “常常”express a repeated habit, so only one should modify the verb phrase.
恐怕 -- “她恐怕儿子会”：担心, this directly expresses the mother’s worry；害怕, this is stronger and expresses fear rather than concern.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness

Coherence (Temporality): 他们才住一个月就又搬家：他们才住了一个月，就又搬家了，both living there and moving are completed past actions, so the 了 completion marker is needed; 就 also clearly links the short stay to the next event.
Coherence (Temporality): 她告诉了孟子：她告诉孟子：，a saying verb that introduces direct speech normally uses the zero particle rather than 了.
Coherence (Conjunction): 一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿：一般人不喜欢卖东西的人，但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，use 但是 to mark the contrast between what most people do and what Mengzi does.
Expressiveness: At the point where Mengzi plays with the sellers, add a market detail to make the setting vivid, for example: “市场里人很多，叫卖声很大。”
Expressiveness: When his mother becomes worried, add her inner thought or a short line of speech, for example: “妈妈心想：‘他不能每天只学着商人玩儿。’”
Encouragement
You clearly show why Mengzi’s mother worries, and the final direct speech gives her a strong, recognizable viewpoint.
You also use a contrast between ordinary people and Mengzi, which helps make his behavior stand out.
Scene 3
你不是当数学家，而是当哲学家，不能当卖东西的人。所以他们又搬家。在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习，他难怪成为有名的哲学家。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
在他们第三个家：在他们的第三个家里，A possessive phrase needs 的 before the noun, and a location phrase here is naturally completed with 里.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Temporality): 所以他们又搬家。：所以他们又搬家了。，“搬家” describes a completed move in the past, so it needs 了 to mark completion.

Coherence (Conjunction): 他难怪成为有名的哲学家。：后来，他成为了有名的哲学家。“难怪” introduces an explanatory “no wonder” conclusion; it cannot introduce the next event in the timeline. “后来” shows sequence, and the completed achievement needs了.
Coherence (Temporality): 告诉了孟子：告诉孟子：，a saying verb that introduces direct speech normally uses the zero particle rather than 了.
Expressiveness: At the description of the new home, add one concrete environmental detail, such as “这儿很安静，学校也在附近。” This helps show why the mother thinks the place is suitable.
Expressiveness: After the mother’s thought, add her feeling, such as “妈妈终于放心了。”This makes her reaction more vivid.
Expressiveness: When describing the son’s studying, add an evaluative detail, such as “孟子每天都认真地看书学习。” This shows his effort rather than only stating the schedule.
Encouragement You used dialogue to show the mother’s hopes for her son, which gives the scene a clear character voice. The phrase “从早到晚学习” also clearly shows how seriously he studied.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Scene 1: Required scene 1 is misremembered. Mengzi and his mother should live near a graveyard, and Mengzi should imitate offering sacrifices every day, not just go there to play.
Scene 1: Required scene 2 needs the specific reason for moving: Mengmu worries that copying sacrifice rituals will negatively influence Mengzi.
Scene 2: Required scene 3 is underdeveloped. The story needs to say that they moved to a neighborhood near the market and that Mengzi imitated buying and selling every day.

Scene 3: Required scene 4 is misremembered and out of order. After leaving the market, they should move near a school, where Mengzi begins studying every day; he should not learn how to worship there.

Overall Encouragement You included Mengmu’s concern for her son and ended with Mengzi becoming a famous philosopher. Your retelling also shows that Mengmu keeps moving to find a better environment for him.
Story 3
Scene 1
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is not used naturally for a general historical setting; use the fixed narrative expression shown in the correction.
老是祭拜：常常祭拜，老是 has a negative or complaining tone, while this sentence describes a neutral repeated activity.
有才两个学校：才有两个学校，才 should come before the verb to mean “there are only two schools.”
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness

Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：一个叫孟子的男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国，follow the first-mention rule: introduce the character with his name in the first noun phrase rather than naming him only after using a pronoun.
Coherence (Reference): 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天：他不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天，follow the close re-occurrence rule: after the previous sentence has named 孟子 and no other male character competes, use a pronoun.
Coherence (Reference): 但是城市才有两个学校：但是那里才有两个学校，follow the close re-occurrence rule: after mentioning his city, use a pronoun-like place reference rather than repeating the noun.
Expressiveness: After 孟子老是祭拜, add his reason or feeling: 他觉得祭拜很有趣。
Expressiveness: At the cemetery scene, add a concrete action to show how he copied others: 他一边笑，一边学别人祭拜。
Expressiveness: After the final sentence, add a short thought to show his mixed feelings:他觉得城市很热闹，可是学校太小了。
Encouragement
You clearly introduce the setting, Mengzi, and his mother at the beginning of the scene. You also used the pattern 不是……就是…… well to show Mengzi’s two usual activities.
Scene 2
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
想孟子有很好的教育：希望孟子受到很好的教育，想 is normally used for what the subject personally wants to do; to express a wish about another person’s education, use希望, and 受到教育 is the natural collocation.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Temporality): 他们搬到有很多学校的城市：他们搬到了有很多学校的城市，use 了 for the completed action of moving to the new city.
Coherence (Conjunction): 他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨：他们从早到晚走路，所以孟子一直抱怨，add 所以 to show the cause-and-effect relation: the long walk caused Mengzi’s complaints.
Expressiveness: After the walking sentence, add Mengzi’s physical feeling to make the complaint more vivid: “孟子走得很累，不想再走了。”
Expressiveness: At the mother’s reason for moving, add an internal thought or quoted speech: “孟母心想：‘我希望孟子受到很好的教育。’”
Encouragement
You clearly show the mother’s reason for moving and use the contrast pattern “不是……而是……” effectively. The phrase “从早到晚” also gives the final sentence a clear sense of how long the journey lasted.
Scene 3
他难怪抱怨，他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市。他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师。跟老师孟子学最重要的文学，所以他成为哲学家。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
他难怪抱怨：难怪他抱怨，难怪 should introduce the reason or explanation before the subject and verb.
他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师：他的妈妈给孟子找了一个老师，找 does not take two objects in this pattern; use 给 to show who the teacher is for, and use 了 for the completed action.
跟老师孟子学最重要的文学：孟子跟老师学最重要的文学，place the subject before the跟老师 phrase.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 他成为哲学家：孟子后来成为了哲学家，repeat the name after another character, 老师, has appeared, because the pronoun could otherwise refer to either person.
Coherence (Temporality): 成为哲学家：后来成为了哲学家，use 了 for the completed change of state, and use 后来 to show that this happened later in the narrative.
Coherence (Conjunction): 他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市：因为他想朋友，也不想离开他的城市，put both reasons after “因为” so that the cause-and-effect connection clearly explains why he complains.
Expressiveness: After the first sentence, add Mengzi’s feeling about leaving his friends, for example: “孟子很难过，说：‘我不想离开朋友。’”
Expressiveness: When his mother finds a teacher, add her purpose or thought, for example: “妈妈希望孟子能好好学习。”
Expressiveness: Describe Mengzi’s study habit with one concrete detail, for example: “孟子每天跟老师看书，还问很多问题。”
Encouragement
You clearly connect Mengzi’s complaints with his wish to stay in his city, and you show an important change when his mother finds him a teacher.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness

Required Scene 2 is unclear: in Scene 2, Meng Mu moves because she wants Meng Zi to have a good education, but the story needs to explain that she worries his daily sacrifice imitation near the graveyard will negatively affect him.
Required Scene 3 is missing: the story needs the move to a neighborhood near the market and Meng Zi’s daily imitation of buying and selling.

Required Scene 4 is misremembered: Scene 2 moves directly to a city with many schools. The story needs Meng Mu to move from the market to a neighborhood near a school, where Meng Zi begins studying every day.
Required Scene 5 is underdeveloped: Scene 3 says Meng Zi becomes a philosopher, but the ending should show that he becomes a famous philosopher.
Overall Encouragement You included Meng Zi, his mother, the graveyard setting, and an ending where he becomes a philosopher. Your story also shows that Meng Mu cares about his education.
Story 4
Scene 1
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
古代的时候：在古代，The time expression should be “在古代” or “古代”; “古代的时候” is not the appropriate form here.
一看很多人：一看到很多人，“看” means to look, while “看到” means to see or notice something; the sentence describes what 神农 noticed.
别人：大家/他们， “别人” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Expressiveness: After “一些人一吃植物就生病了,” add one physical symptom to make the danger clearer, for example: “有的人肚子疼得不得了。”
Expressiveness: At “神农想帮别人,” add 神农’s inner thought to show his motivation, for example: “神农想：我一定要找出能吃的植物。”
Expressiveness: When describing the people eating plants, add a small detail about their action, for example: “很多人随便摘路边的植物吃。”
Encouragement You clearly introduce 神农 before using his name, so the reader can follow who the scene is about. You also use “正在” well to show that people are in the middle of walking and eating.
Scene 2
然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
一些植物吃真好：一些植物很好吃，The verb “吃” cannot directly describe a plant’s taste in this structure; use an adjective phrase such as “很好吃,” or use “吃起来” before the adjective.
一些植物毒得很：一些植物有毒，Use “有毒” to mean “poisonous.” “毒得很” does not naturally describe a plant in this context.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Expressiveness: After “特别是黄瓜,” add a simple sensory detail such as “黄瓜吃起来又脆又清爽。” This makes the good-tasting plants more vivid.
Expressiveness: After mentioning “夹竹桃,” add Shen Nong’s reaction, such as “神农觉得这种花很漂亮，想试一试。” This can show his thoughts before he tastes it.
Encouragement

You used “然后” to connect this scene clearly to the earlier events, and “但是” creates a useful contrast between edible plants and dangerous ones. Your examples of several vegetables also make Shen Nong’s tasting activity feel specific.
Scene 3
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：请问，我们可以吃什么植物？，麻烦 cannot introduce a polite question in this way; 请问 is the appropriate expression for politely asking a question.

这就要看你想不想生病了：什么植物能吃，这就要看这种植物有没有毒了，this pattern must answer an uncertain condition and use an open or A-not-A question after 看; whether someone wants to be ill does not determine whether a plant is edible.
以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃，when a new sentence means “afterwards,” use 后来 rather than 以后.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Temporality): 后来，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，神农告诉了别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃，use 了 for the completed action of telling people in this later event.
Expressiveness: At the question, add a feeling or reason to make the speaker’s concern clearer, such as “一个人担心地问：‘请问，我们可以吃什么植物？’”
Expressiveness: When Shen Nong answers, add one concrete example from this scene, such as “神农说：‘有毒的植物不能吃，像生姜这样的植物可以吃。’”
Encouragement
You used dialogue effectively to show an interaction between Shen Nong and another person. You also clearly contrasted plants that can be eaten with plants that cannot be eaten.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Scene 2: The required tea discovery is missing. The story needs 神农 to find “茶” and make a record of it.
Scene 2: The 夹竹桃 event is incomplete. The story needs 神农 to eat 夹竹桃 and faint.
Scene 2: The person in blue and 灵芝 rescue are missing. The story needs someone in blue to give 神农 “灵芝,” and 神农 to feel better after eating it.
Scene 3: The required person in brown and their conversation with 神农 are missing.
Scene 3: The ending needs 神农 to record both “灵芝” and “夹竹桃,” not only generally tell people which plants are safe.

Overall Encouragement You included the important beginning problem: people became sick from unknown plants, and神农 wanted to help. You also clearly showed that 神农 began trying plants and learned that 夹竹桃 was dangerous.
Story 5
Scene 1
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
古代的时候：在古代，this is the standard time expression for a story set in ancient times.
他找很多植物：他找到了很多植物，“找” means “to look for,” while “找到” means “to find”; use “了” because this is a completed action in the narrative.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农：有一位叫神农的男人觉得植物很有意思，follow the first-mention rule: introduce a new character with the name and a full noun phrase when the character first appears.
Expressiveness: After the stomach pain, add the character’s frightened thought: 他想：“我会死吗？”
Expressiveness: When mentioning the plants, add one simple visual detail to make the scene more vivid, such as 黄色的花又大又漂亮。

Encouragement You created a clear contrast between plants that cause pain and plants that make the character feel well. The strong expression for the stomach pain also makes the danger easy to imagine.
Scene 2
凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
凉山很大的山：凉山是一座很大的山，A noun phrase needs the copula 是 to state what a place is, and 一座 is the appropriate measure-word phrase for a mountain.
这也找植物：他也在这里找植物，这 means “this” and cannot refer to Shennong as the actor; use 他 for the known character and 在这里 for the location.
找到黄色的花：找到了一朵黄色的花，This is a completed discovery, so use 了; a single flower also needs the measure word 朵.
跟黄色的花做茶：用黄色的花做茶，Use 用 to introduce the material or ingredient used to make something; 跟 does not express this relationship here.
头发疼死：头疼死了，头发 means “hair,” which cannot hurt in the intended sense. Use头疼 for a headache; 疼死了 is a natural intensifying expression.
这冰茶：这种冰茶，这/那 + MW. + noun.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 你：（delete），The pronoun 你 has no introduced referent or addressee. This is a general statement about tea, so no person needs to be named here.
Expressiveness: At the moment Shennong finds the flower, add a visual detail to make it memorable, for example: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”
Expressiveness: After he drinks the tea, add his physical feeling or thought, for example:“他觉得肚子疼得厉害，心想：这不是药吗？”
Expressiveness: You could add a short line showing why he believes the tea is useful, for example: “神农听说，这种茶可以让人更有精神。”
Encouragement

You used the useful story-time phrase “一天” and clearly showed a sequence: Shennong finds a flower, hears about tea, and then tries it. You are also beginning to use cause-and-result-style ideas such as a tea being helpful for pain.
Scene 3
糟糕，这黄色的花是夹竹桃，特别是毒。正好在这儿，灵芝药的夹竹桃他吃完了，也写一个课文的植物。谢谢神农。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
特别是毒：特别有毒，Use 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant. 是 cannot directly link the adverb 特别 to the adjective 毒 in this structure.
灵芝药的夹竹桃：灵芝和夹竹桃，The original phrase does not form a valid noun phrase:的 must connect a modifier to a noun, but 灵芝药 cannot modify 夹竹桃 in this way.
写一个课文的植物：写下这些植物，Use 写下 when recording plants or information. 课文 cannot be used as a modifier before 植物 here.
这黄色的花是夹竹桃：这种黄色的花，这/那 + MW. + noun.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Temporality): 吃完了：吃完，In a series of completed actions, only the last verb takes 了. Here, remove 了 from 吃完 and put it on the final action: 写下了.
Expressiveness: After the discovery that the flower is poisonous, add a physical reaction to show the danger, such as：神农的肚子马上疼了起来。
Expressiveness: Describe the yellow flower before naming it, using a simple image from the model story, such as：黄色的花像星星一样，又大又漂亮。
Expressiveness: Add a short thought or line of speech when Shennong realizes the danger, such as：神农想：“原来这种花不能吃！”
Encouragement
You clearly identify the yellow flower as 夹竹桃 and use 糟糕 to show a strong reaction. You also include both 灵芝 and 夹竹桃, which gives this scene important plant-related detail.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Required Scene 1: In Scene 1, the story needs to explain that people often became sick because they did not know which plants were safe to eat.
Required Scene 2: Scene 1 says Shennong looked for plants, but it needs his clear decision to discover safe and unsafe plants and that he climbed mountains to try them.
Required Scene 3: Scene 2 does not clearly show Shennong finding tea and making a record of it; it mixes tea with the yellow flower and says he feels unwell.
Required Scene 4: In Scenes 2–3, the yellow flower is identified as 夹竹桃, but Shennong needs to eat it and faint.
Required Scene 5: Scene 3 needs a person in blue who gives Shennong 灵芝, followed by Shennong feeling better after eating it.
Required Scene 6: The story is missing the person in brown and that person’s conversation with Shennong.
Required Scene 7: Scene 3 needs to clearly show Shennong recording both 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.

Overall Encouragement You included Shennong, plants, tea, 夹竹桃, and 灵芝, so you remembered several important parts of the story. Your story also has a clear attempt at showing that some plants can help while others can hurt.
Story 6
Scene 1
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
古代时候：在古代，use the standard time expression with 在 before a historical period.
什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么植物是危险的，adjectives used after 是 need 的, and the two parallel clauses should be separated with a comma.
试一试很多种植物：尝一尝很多种植物，尝 is the appropriate verb for tasting or eating plants; 试一试 usually means trying out or testing something.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 人不知道他们能吃什么植物：人们不知道什么植物能吃，use zero form rather than repeating a pronoun for the same referent within one clause.
Coherence (Reference): 神农：一位叫神农的老人，follow the first-mention rule by introducing a new character with both a name and a brief description.
Coherence (Conjunction): 但是不知道为什么，没有办法：人们不知道为什么，也没有办法，but does not express contrast here; 也 links two related problems.
Expressiveness: After the people’s problem, add an emotional detail such as “人们很害怕，不敢随便吃路边的植物。” to show why the situation is serious.
Expressiveness: When introducing Shennong, show his determination with a thought such as “神农想：‘我一定要找出能吃的植物。’”
Expressiveness: Add one simple setting detail as he begins his journey, such as “他走到高山上，看到了很多不一样的植物。”
Encouragement
You clearly explain the central problem before introducing Shennong’s action, and your use of “所以” gives the scene a logical direction.
Scene 2
发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚。他告诉朋友：“你吃哪种植物，这就要看你的口味。比方说，你爱吃甜的，可能喜欢糖。”他最喜欢吃花，除了夹竹桃以外，什么都花想吃。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：让肚子感觉又暖和又舒服，清楚 does not describe a physical feeling in the stomach; 舒服 correctly describes a pleasant bodily sensation.
你吃哪种植物，这就要看你的口味：你喜欢吃哪种植物？这要看你的口味，this use of这就要看 needs an uncertain question or condition before it; here, a direct question followed by 这要看 makes the meaning clear.
什么都花想吃：什么花都想吃，when 什么 modifies the noun 花, the noun must come directly after 什么, and 都 follows the whole noun phrase.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 发现有的植物：神农发现……，here needs a Subj.
Expressiveness: At the tea discovery, add a simple detail about what happens when tea is put in water, such as “神农把茶放在热水里，水变成了淡淡的颜色。”
Expressiveness: After discovering tea’s benefits, add Shennong’s thoughts to show his excitement: “神农想：茶不但好喝，对身体也有好处。”
Expressiveness: In the quoted speech, make Shennong sound more helpful by giving a clearer example: “甜的东西很好吃，可是也不能吃太多。”
Encouragement
You use direct speech to show what Shennong tells his friend, which makes the scene more lively.
The phrase “除了夹竹桃以外” is a good way to express an exception.
Scene 3
他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。一吃就开始死。但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。
Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
一百岁时候：一百岁的时候，Age expressions followed by a time clause need 的 before时候.
一吃就开始死：一吃就快要死了，死 describes an endpoint, so it does not naturally follow 开始; 快要死了 expresses that the character is close to dying.
毒的花：有毒的花，Use 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant.
什么植物是毒：什么植物有毒，Use 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant; 是毒 does not work naturally as a description of a plant.
Vocabulary Suggestions
No suggestions.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 这个口味：一种味道，This is a first mention in the current scene, so the demonstrative needs an established referent; use an indefinite noun phrase for a newly introduced taste.
Coherence (Temporality): 他发现：他发现了，Use 了 for the completed action of discovering something.
Coherence (Temporality): 告诉人：告诉了人们，Use 了 because the telling is presented as a completed action.
Coherence (Conjunction): 但是：虽然他生病了，但是他，Contrast needs the paired pattern 虽然……但是…… when the character tells people despite being ill.
Expressiveness: After the poisonous flower is eaten, add a physical reaction such as “他肚子疼了起来，难受得不得了。”
Expressiveness: Describe the flower before the character eats it, for example: “那儿开着黄色的、像星星一样的花。”
Expressiveness: Add the character’s fearful thought at the dangerous moment: “我会死吗？”
Encouragement

You used the immediate-result pattern “一……就……” effectively to show that the danger happens quickly. You also clearly tried to explain the important difference between medicinal plants and poisonous plants.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Required Scene 3 is incomplete: in Scene 2, Shennong finds tea, but he does not make a record of it.
Required Scene 4 is misremembered: in Scene 3, Shennong eats a poisonous flower, but the story needs him to try “夹竹桃” and faint.
Required Scene 5 is missing: after fainting, a person in blue should give Shennong “灵芝,”and he should feel better after eating it.
Required Scene 6 is missing: another person in brown should come and have a conversation with Shennong.
Required Scene 7 is missing: Shennong should record both “灵芝” and “夹竹桃” at the end.

Overall Encouragement You included the important beginning problem and showed that Shennong wanted to help people learn which plants were safe. You also remembered tea and the idea of poisonous plants.

comments.text: This one is in S4 but missing in S5. it is a vocab error. And the key of this error is: 恐怕 cannot take other Subj. except for 我 before it.
